title: BlockShop
tagline: Dapp for E-commerce and microfinace in single Ecosystem that Easy to use
description: The BlockShop is a decentralized application built on the Celo blockchain, designed to streamline digital payments, product purchases, and microloan management. The platform leverages Celo's stable token to facilitate seamless transactions while ensuring transparency, security, and decentralization.
how_its_made: The BlockShop is dapp that merges e-commerce and microfinance into single ecosystem, which i not that hard if we use smart contract on the project. In this project we only used 1 partner tech which is Celo, It's so easy when we want to deploy the smart contract into chain. And also Celo have celo.academy for me go through and import some fun stuff that make me build my project faster.
